name: enterprise-agents
description: Plataforma local de gerenciamento e orquestração de agentes de IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @ea/server" "npm run dev -w @ea/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @ea/server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @ea/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
